[SWS_Fr_00453] ⌈The Fr module shall use the BSW Scheduler mechanisms for
data consistency when required.⌋
Other Module dependencies:
• [SWS_Fr_00454] ⌈On certain systems the CC might share resources with other
components (e.g., the MCU), and might depend on their configurations. If those
resources are within the scope of the other modules (e.g., PLL configuration,
memory mapping), then the Fr module doesn’t configure those components but
requires that their initialization precede the Fr module’s initialization.⌋
